items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Does Ed know that -- about his recording of it? [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, I think so. Yes.

ctx.x: But the second one is called "Once Upon a Time It Happened " -- and that was because the lyricist, you know, wrote -- used that title for the song, not knowing that I had another song called "Once Upon a Time" --and Dean Martin liked the song, and recorded it.
Does Ed know that -- about his recording of it?
